university-of-florida.about:
UF is one of the largest universities in the US and a member of the Association of American Universities. It offers 300+ undergraduate programmes across 16 colleges, plus special pathways such as the online PaCE programme and the Innovation Academy (spring/summer schedule).

International applicants with a non-US high school do not submit the Florida STARS self-reported record but follow UF's international requirements. Test scores are required and must arrive by the materials deadline of the chosen round.
university-of-florida.aid_intl: Very limited for international students (not eligible for federal or Florida state aid).
university-of-florida.tests: SAT, ACT or CLT required for all first-year applicants (Florida Board of Governors rule 6.002), superscored. International applicants must show English proficiency (see UF international page).
requirements: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT or ACT scores (required)
English test: required for non-native speakers (see UF international requirements)
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
UF application questions
Application fee (see UF website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

university-of-illinois-chicago.about:
UIC is part of the University of Illinois system and home to the largest medical school in the US, so nursing, pharmacy, public health and pre-health tracks are strong. Engineering, computer science and the College of Architecture, Design and the Arts are also popular, with the Chicago job market on the doorstep.

International first-years can apply Early Action by 2 November or Regular Decision by 1 February and must meet published English minimums.
university-of-illinois-chicago.aid_intl: Limited for international students; some UIC scholarships (e.g. via the Honors College) require separate applications.
university-of-illinois-chicago.tests: English minimums: TOEFL iBT 80 or 4.5 (new scale), IELTS Academic 6.5, PTE 54, Duolingo 120 (accepted from fall 2027).
requirements: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
English test: TOEFL 80 / 4.5, IELTS 6.5, Duolingo 120, PTE 54
Personal statement
Application fee (see UIC website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

university-of-maryland-college-park.about:
UMD's College Park campus is a short metro ride from Washington, D.C., giving students access to federal agencies, research labs such as NASA Goddard and NIST, and policy internships. Computer science, engineering, criminology and the Robert H. Smith School of Business are particularly strong.

International first-years use the same deadlines as US students. Applying Early Action gives priority consideration for admission and merit scholarships. English proficiency is required unless waived, and non-US credentials are evaluated by UMD.
university-of-maryland-college-park.aid_intl: International students are not eligible for federal aid; UMD's freshman merit scholarships are awarded at admission (apply by Early Action for priority consideration) - check eligibility on the merit scholarships page.
university-of-maryland-college-park.tests: Test-optional through the fall 2027 cycle. English: TOEFL iBT 95 (0-120 scale) or 5 (new 1-6 scale), IELTS 7, Duolingo 120; lower scores may be referred to the Maryland English Institute.

university-of-notre-dame.about:
Nearly all Notre Dame undergraduates live in one of its residence halls, which act as lifelong communities. The Mendoza College of Business is consistently top-ranked, and the university is strong in economics, political science, engineering and pre-health.

Notre Dame is need-blind for international applicants and will reinstate a testing requirement from the 2027-28 cycle (fall 2028 entry); fall 2027 applicants can still apply test-optional.
university-of-notre-dame.aid_intl: Need-blind admission for international first-year applicants; those who want need-based aid must complete the CSS Profile. Notre Dame meets full demonstrated need.
university-of-notre-dame.tests: Test-optional for fall 2027 applicants; SAT/ACT will be required again from fall 2028 entry. English proficiency evidence for non-native speakers (see international applicants page).
requirements: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT/ACT scores (optional: test-optional policy)
English test: English proficiency evidence for non-native speakers
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Notre Dame supplemental essays
School counselor report + 1 teacher recommendation

Financial aid forms if requesting aid (CSS Profile and/or the university's international aid form)

university-of-ottawa.about:
uOttawa sits in downtown Ottawa next to Parliament Hill, so political science, public administration, international affairs and law are natural strengths, alongside medicine, engineering and the Telfer School of Management. Students can take programmes in English, French or both, and many include co-op.

International applicants apply through OUAC. Because programmes reach capacity quickly, apply as soon as possible and before 15 January.
university-of-ottawa.aid_intl: International students who study in French can receive the Differential Tuition Fee Exemption Scholarship, which reduces fees to the Canadian rate; there are also international English scholarships.
university-of-ottawa.tests: SAT/ACT not required. Proof of English or French proficiency depending on the language of the programme (see uOttawa admission requirements).
requirements: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
Secondary school diploma / final exam results (predicted results accepted when applying)
OUAC 105 online application (international applicants to Ontario universities)
English test: English or French proficiency, depending on programme language
OUAC application fee (see OUAC)
Proof of funds / certification of finances for the I-20 or study permit (after admission)
Valid passport (needed for the visa / study permit)

university-of-queensland.about:
The University of Queensland, founded in 1909, has its main campus at St Lucia on the Brisbane River and is a member of Australia's Group of Eight. It is internationally known for biotechnology, life sciences, environmental science, engineering, business and medicine, and for research commercialisation.

International undergraduates apply online with their school results and English test, and can enter through UQ English pathway programmes if they fall short. Brisbane's lower living costs compared with Sydney and Melbourne make UQ a popular choice.
university-of-queensland.aid_intl: UQ scholarships for international students are listed at scholarships.uq.edu.au.
university-of-queensland.tests: Minimum English for most programmes: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in every band (IELTS One Skill Retake accepted with the original test; IELTS Online not recognised); equivalent TOEFL/PTE scores per UQ's table; some programmes need more. Students below the level can take UQ English pathways.

university-of-reading.about:
The University of Reading has a large parkland campus at Whiteknights, about 25 minutes by train from London. It is internationally known for meteorology and climate science, Henley Business School, real estate and planning, agriculture and food science.

Apply through UCAS. BSc Economics asks ABB (maths preferred) or IB 32 with 5 in SL Maths. Reading’s Global Sustainability Leaders Scholarship gives up to 400 students £6,000 a year towards living costs.
university-of-reading.aid_intl: Global Sustainability Leaders Scholarship: £6,000 a year towards living costs for up to four years, up to 400 awards a year for high-achieving UK and overseas students interested in sustainability.
university-of-reading.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: e.g. Economics IELTS 6.5 with no component below 5.5; pre-sessional and International Foundation routes available.
university-of-reading.gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. BSc Economics: ABB (Maths preferred) or IB 32 with 5 in SL Maths.

School-leaving qualification or predicted grades (A-levels, IB, or recognised national diploma)

university-of-rochester.about:
Rochester's 'Rochester Curriculum' has no general-education requirements beyond a primary major and clusters in other areas, giving students wide freedom. It hosts the Institute of Optics, the oldest optics programme in the US, the Eastman School of Music and a large medical centre.

For fall 2026 it received 22,558 first-year applications and admitted 9,842 (44%). Internationals who need aid submit the CSS Profile; others submit the International Financial Support Form. Optional items include a writing sample and a family/peer recommendation.
university-of-rochester.aid_intl: Merit scholarships and need-based aid are available, but financial need is a contributing factor in admission for international applicants (need-aware), so admission is highly selective for those requesting aid.
university-of-rochester.tests: Test-optional (no disadvantage for not submitting, also for scholarships). Admitted fall 2026: SAT EBRW 700-760, SAT Math 730-790, ACT 31-35; 34% admitted without tests. English exam results (or a waiver request) required for non-native speakers.
university-of-rochester.gpa_note: Admitted students fall 2026: SAT EBRW 700-760, Math 730-790, ACT 31-35; enrolled average recalculated GPA 3.77.
requirements: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
SAT/ACT scores (optional: test-optional policy)
English test: English exam results or waiver request
Common App personal essay (up to 650 words)
Rochester supplemental essay
School counselor report + 1 teacher recommendation
CSS Profile (if requesting aid) or International Financial Support Form
Application fee (see Rochester website); fee waivers available for eligible applicants
Interview (optional / offered to some applicants)

university-of-strathclyde.about:
The University of Strathclyde is a city-centre university in Glasgow focused on “useful learning”, with a large engineering faculty, the Strathclyde Business School, pharmacy, law and economics. Scottish honours degrees normally last four years, with second-year entry possible for strong A-level/IB applicants.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks ABB–BBB at A-level or IB 30–32 (no subject below 5). International fees are lower than many UK peers.
university-of-strathclyde.aid_intl: Scholarships for international students are listed in Strathclyde’s scholarship search.
university-of-strathclyde.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English requirements are set by country on Strathclyde’s international entry requirements pages.
university-of-strathclyde.gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics: ABB–BBB, or IB 32–30 with no subject below 5.
requirements: Secondary school transcripts (final 2–3 years)
School-leaving qualification or predicted grades (A-levels, IB, or recognised national diploma)
UCAS personal statement (three structured questions)

university-of-surrey.about:
The University of Surrey sits on a hillside campus in Guildford, 35 minutes from London. It is known for its Professional Training placement year, hospitality and tourism management, engineering, economics, health sciences and veterinary medicine.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks AAB (ABB with A-level Maths or Economics) or IB 34, and IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in writing. International fees are relatively moderate at £22,700 for Economics.
university-of-surrey.aid_intl: Scholarships and bursaries listed in Surrey’s funding search; many degrees include a professional training placement year.
university-of-surrey.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: e.g. Economics IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.0 in writing and 5.5 in other elements.
university-of-surrey.gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics: AAB (ABB with A-level Maths/Economics), or IB 34 (33 with HL Maths/Economics).

university-of-sussex.about:
The University of Sussex has a modernist campus on the edge of the South Downs, a short train ride from Brighton. It is internationally known for development studies (with the Institute of Development Studies), international relations, economics, psychology and media.

Apply through UCAS. Economics asks ABB–BBB or IB 32 and IELTS 6.0. International students can receive Global Flourishing awards worth £5,000–6,000 off first-year tuition.
university-of-sussex.aid_intl: Global Flourishing Scholarship (£5,000 off first-year tuition) and Global Flourishing Award for India (£6,000) for international students.
university-of-sussex.tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: e.g. Economics IELTS Academic 6.0 with at least 5.5 in each component.
university-of-sussex.gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics BSc: ABB–BBB, or IB 32.

university-of-sydney.about:
Founded in 1850, the University of Sydney is Australia's oldest university and a member of the Group of Eight. Its Camperdown/Darlington campus hosts a broad range of faculties, with particular strength in medicine and health, law, business, engineering, architecture and veterinary science.

International students check the entry requirements on each course page, apply online (directly or via an agent), accept the offer and pay first-semester fees to receive a Confirmation of Enrolment for the visa. The standard English requirement is IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0.
university-of-sydney.aid_intl: Over A$135 million in scholarships awarded each year; international scholarships are listed on the University's international scholarships page, and around 200 Australia Awards recipients are supported annually.
university-of-sydney.tests: Standard English requirement: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0 (some courses higher); TOEFL iBT (Australia version, Home Edition not accepted), PTE and LanguageCert accepted via the concordance table. Tests must be under two years old at course start.

university-of-victoria.about:
UVic hosts Ocean Networks Canada and major climate research institutes, and runs one of Canada's largest co-op programmes across engineering, computer science, business and the sciences. It is mid-sized and campus-focused, in a city often ranked among the best small cities in the world.

International students apply online; those who submit completed grades early (by December) can receive early offers.
university-of-victoria.aid_intl: Entrance scholarships and funding for international students; see UVic scholarships & funding page.
university-of-victoria.tests: SAT/ACT not required. English proficiency required for applicants whose first language is not English (see UVic international page).
requirements: Secondary school transcript (grades from the last 3-4 years)
Secondary school diploma / final exam results (predicted results accepted when applying)

unsw-sydney.about:
UNSW, founded in 1949 in Kensington, Sydney, is a research-intensive member of Australia's Group of Eight, known for engineering, computer science, business, law, medicine and the built environment, and for strong industry and startup links. It currently runs three terms a year, moving to a new academic calendar from 2028.

International undergraduates apply directly through the UNSW Applicant Portal (or a UNSW agent) using IB, A-level, US or other national qualifications set out in the 2027 entry requirements. Apply early: offshore Term 1 2027 applications close 15 November 2026, and offers are prioritised by academic merit and place availability.
unsw-sydney.aid_intl: International undergraduate scholarships (including the International Student Award for eligible countries) are listed on the UNSW scholarships pages; awards consider leadership and extracurriculars as well as grades.
unsw-sydney.tests: English: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (min 6.0 in each band) or TOEFL iBT 90 (min 23 writing, 22 reading, listening, speaking); PTE Academic and C1 Advanced also accepted; some degrees require more. IELTS Online not accepted; the new TOEFL format is under review.

vanderbilt-university.about:
Vanderbilt has four undergraduate schools: Arts and Science, Engineering, Peabody College of education and human development, and the Blair School of Music. Its medical centre and Nashville's music and healthcare industries create strong internship options.

In fall 2026 Vanderbilt enrolled 7,516 undergraduates (13,813 total) and admitted 2,519 of 54,792 first-year applicants. International applicants who request aid are reviewed need-aware; those admitted receive packages without loans.
vanderbilt-university.aid_intl: Need-aware for international students who apply for aid (they compete among other international aid applicants). For fall 2026 Vanderbilt gave need-based aid and/or merit scholarships to 89 international students from 54 countries, worth USD 16,815-99,998 per year for four years.
vanderbilt-university.tests: SAT/ACT optional for fall 2027 and 2028 entry (required again from fall 2029). Fall 2026 middle 50%: ACT 34-35, SAT EBRW 730-760, SAT Math 770-790. English test for non-native speakers (see Vanderbilt testing policies).
vanderbilt-university.gpa_note: Fall 2026 middle 50%: ACT 34-35; SAT EBRW 730-760; SAT Math 770-790.
